desc:
🥔 Peel a GIANT potato in space!

Start with a toothpick and scrape your way up to huge peeling machines. Sell your peel, upgrade your tools, hire robots, and peel every last bit of skin.

🚀 Play solo or with up to 6 friends
🔧 Unlock 14 tools and machines
🤖 Robots peel for you
⭐ Easy, Normal and Hard potatoes
🏆 Climb the Top Peelers leaderboard

Can you peel the whole potato?
